in_marathi.name: Mohnish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon god's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohnish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', meaning 'to charm or attract'. The name Mohnish signifies the grace and blessings of the Moon god. It is believed that this name brings prosperity and happiness to the bearer.

vedic_reference.note: Mohanish is a variation of the name Mohan, which is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', meaning 'to delight' or 'to attract'. It is also the name of the Hindu god Mohan, who is a form of Lord Krishna, known for his enchanting and captivating nature.
